title: portulacastrum monogynum
intro: Portulacastrum monogynum, commonly known as Indian starflower, is a plant species in the family Portulacaceae, characterized by its star-shaped flowers and edible leaves. The health benefits of Portulacastrum monogynum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Portulacastrum monogynum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
